Name: CSP - Sapling Starter Package
Author: DraconisLeonidas
Description:
You ever get bored with starting the same way every game? Don't get me wrong, I love the farming aspect of Stardew Valley, but sometimes I just don't want to bother with crops at the very start and instead focus entirely on other things like foraging and mining. I could just [i]choose[/i] not to plant the seeds the game gives you, obviously, but it doesn't have a good gamefeel, at least to me. So I figured hey, why not use that new Custom Starter Package framework to adjust it? Obviously, this starter package focuses on fruit trees, giving you one each of the least profitable vanilla sapling for Summer and Fall, with a bonus Winter sapling for if you have PPJA More Trees installed. (This is an optional requirement, the pack will work even without PPJA More Trees installed.)

[u]Contents[/u]
[list]
[*]Parsnip Seeds x1 - This is purely for the starting quest, as leaving it undone in the log annoys me specifically.
[*]Orange Sapling x1
[*]Apple Sapling x1
[/list]
[u]Bonus for PPJA More Trees[/u]
[list]
[*]Yuzu Sapling x1
[/list]
[u]Potential Future Updates[/u]
[list]
[*]Config support with the ability to toggle getting the parsnip seeds
[*]Configurable added items like a slightly better starting weapon, fishing rod, and/or resources
[*]Toggleable other saplings (more profitable ones, Ginger Island ones, more from More Trees, etc)
[*]Support for saplings from other mods. Feel free to make suggestions!
[/list]
